app.name: Shopify
app.review_note: Checked against provider sources on 2 November 2026; corrections are listed in VERIFICATION.md.

summary.headline: You can create a Shopify app for your own store right away, but distributing to other merchants needs a Partner account and review, and order and customer data need separate approvals.

difficulty_factors.reason: A Partner account is needed to distribute apps to other merchants; merchants can create custom apps for their own store.
Access to all orders and to protected customer data must be requested and approved in the Partner Dashboard, and App Store listing has its own review.
Scope approvals are reported at two to four weeks by a third party; no App Store review time was found.
No registration fee was mentioned in the sources checked.
You must set up a Partner account and a development store, and request approvals manually.

setup_effort.estimate: About 1-2 hours including a development store (estimate)

approval_wait.label: None found for your own store; scope approvals reported at 2-4 weeks (third party); App Store review time not found

can_start_today.reason: You can sign up for a Shopify Partner account and create an app in the Dev Dashboard immediately.

confidence.reason: Scope and data approvals come from Shopify's docs; Partner-account and timing details come partly from community and third-party sources, and no official App Store review time was found.

summary.type_note: Custom apps for your own store are self-serve. Apps for other merchants need a Partner account and review, and some data scopes need approval in the Partner Dashboard.

blockers.title: Protected customer data approval
blockers.detail: By default apps cannot access protected customer data. The API does not return it from non-development stores until the app is approved, and orders contain customer data.
blockers.workaround: Request protected customer data access in the Partner Dashboard early, and develop against a development store meanwhile.

blockers.title: Only the last 60 days of orders by default
blockers.detail: To read older orders you must request the read_all_orders scope in the Partner Dashboard and wait for approval.
blockers.workaround: Request access early. A third party reports two to four weeks.

blockers.title: Partner account needed to distribute to other merchants
blockers.detail: Custom apps for a single store can be created from a merchant account, but distributing to other merchants needs a Partner account. Merchant-created custom apps on Basic and Starter plans cannot access protected customer data.
blockers.workaround: Create a free Partner account if you plan to serve more than one store.

steps.title: Create a Shopify Partner Account
steps.action: Sign up for a Shopify Partner account (needed to distribute to other merchants) to access the Dev Dashboard.
steps.why_human_only: Requires signing up for a business-related account and accepting terms.

steps.title: Register App in Dev Dashboard
steps.action: Navigate to the Partner Dashboard, create a new app, and configure your redirect URI.
steps.why_human_only: Requires access to the authenticated Partner Dashboard.

steps.title: Implement OAuth Flow
steps.action: Use the Shopify CLI or your preferred stack to implement OAuth 2.0 based on the official documentation.
steps.why_human_only: Requires writing custom code for the integration.

steps.title: Request approvals for sensitive data
steps.action: In the Partner Dashboard open your app, then API access. Request read_all_orders and protected customer data access if your agent needs them, describing your use case.

scopes.purpose: Read product data from the shop
Modify order data. Orders contain customer data, so reading it also needs protected customer data approval.
Read all orders instead of only the last 60 days. Must be requested in the Partner Dashboard.

common_rejection_reasons.reason: API returns an error saying the topic or object contains protected customer data
common_rejection_reasons.fix: Complete Shopify's protected customer data requirements and request access in the Partner Dashboard.
Request the read_all_orders scope in the Partner Dashboard.

evidence.claim: Shopify's developer docs describe building apps; the documentation landing page loaded.

By default apps see only the last 60 days of orders; read_all_orders must be requested in the Partner Dashboard; protected customer data is not returned from non-development stores until the app is approved.
A Shopify staff reply separates custom apps created from a Partner account and from a merchant account; merchant-created custom apps on Basic and Starter plans cannot access protected customer data.
Third-party integration docs say a Shopify Partner account is needed to connect via OAuth, and approval is needed for protected customer data on published public apps.
Third-party docs report that approval for the read_all_orders scope typically takes two to four weeks.
No official Shopify App Store review duration was found in the sources checked.
